name: Amazon (via GPUDojo tracker) price page for amd-radeon-pro-vii
notes: Amazon new offer $1,399, tracked 2026-10-19 02:17 UTC. Same page shows eBay new asking $750 and used eBay asks of $299.99 (Oct 9), $319.99 (Sep 1), $349.99 (Aug 28), $385 (Aug 21) - i.e. the USED street is roughly $300-350, so $1,399 new badly overstates the realistic buy-in for this 2019 Vega card. Newegg had no current offer; Amazon/Newegg product pages were bot-blocked here, so figure comes from the tracker. All figures are ASKING prices.
